[June 2021]

[Project: Self Sufficiency]

The Islamic Republic of Iran announces the expansion of the Natanz Enrichment Facility.

Currently the Facility has the Capacity of 50.000 IR1 centrifuges which is nowhere near enough to supply the Nuclear Reactors of Iran such as the Bushehr Reactor and the newly built nuclear reactors or nuclear desalination plants. The Bushehr Nuclear reactor would need 126.000 IR1 type centrifuges to maintain full operational capability with Iranian Enriched Uranium.

After the Expansion Natanz Enrichment Facility will have a capacity of 250.000 IR2m or IR4 type centrifuges.

To power Iran's current nuclear facilities Iran would need 3.000.000 IR1 type centrifuges or 600.000 IR2m/IR4 type centrifuges, Russia is currently supplying Irans need of low enriched uranium

The Expansion is estimated to cost $ 220.000.000 and is estimated to be able to start housing centrifuges in 2025, after which it will be filled with IR2m and IR4 type centrifuges.

The Expansion of Natanz as well as housing additional centrifuges past 2025 is in accordance with the JCPOA or commonly referred to as the Iran Nuclear Deal.
